GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 240 (9 Oct 45) GA
(SCAPIN - 113)
APO 500
9 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Payment of Bonus to Japanese Soldiers of Korean Descent.
1. It has been reported that Koreans returning to Korea from Japan claim that a bonus is being paid to Japanese soldiers on discharge from the Japanese Army while soldiers of Korean decent are denied such bonus.
2. An early report is desired as to whether any discrimination is being made in the final payment of Japanese and Koreans upon discharge, and if so the reason therefor.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/S/H. W. Allen,
/t/H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
